title: Jacobi theta modular inversion: heat kernel T <-> 1/T duality
latent_structure: The lattice parameter tau (Im tau>0) is the modular generator of the periodic heat kernel. Poisson summation / Jacobi inversion tau |-> -1/tau reconstructs the dual-temperature expansion of theta_3, the periodized Gaussian Green function on a circle (DLMF 20.13.4). One master theta, two reconstructions (direct vs inverted nome). Not CSE of two Fourier series.

function_domains.theta_3: Jacobi theta theta_3(z|tau)=theta_3(z,q) with q=exp(I*pi*tau), entire in z for each tau in the upper half-plane (DLMF 20.2, 20.1)

nonzero_conditions.label: DERIVED
nonzero_conditions.source: DLMF 20.7.viii: tau' = -1/tau; excluded already by Im tau>0

positivity_conditions.label: DECLARED
positivity_conditions.source: DLMF 20.1: lattice parameter tau with Im tau>0; nome q=exp(I*pi*tau) satisfies 0<|q|<1

analytic_domains.label: DERIVED
analytic_domains.source: Im tau>0 implies Im(-1/tau)>0; 20.7.30--33 are stated with that inversion

branch_conventions: all square roots assume their principal values (DLMF 20.7.viii sentence immediately before 20.7.30--33)

limit_domains.statement: the singular kernel limit Im tau -> 0+ is not this identity (distributional Green functions, 20.13 last paragraph)
limit_domains.label: DECLARED
limit_domains.source: DLMF 20.13: 'In the singular limit Im tau -> 0+ ... distribution-valued Green functions'; 20.7.32 is for Im tau>0

source_provenance: NIST DLMF 20.13.4 (periodized Gaussian = theta_3; thermal/heat reading) https://dlmf.nist.gov/20.13.E4

derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: tau' = -1/tau with tau finite and nonzero

why_not_cse_lgg: Two theta evaluations at modularly inverted lattice parameters, times a Gaussian prefactor, are not a shared subexpression. LGG does not invent the modular generator tau |-> -1/tau or Poisson summation. The compact object is the modular invariant of the heat kernel.
proposer_leak_risk: Source names theta_3 and tau'=-1/tau. Do not leak 'Poisson summation', 'T dual to 1/T', 'periodized Gaussian Green function', or 'modular invariant generator' as gold names.
notes: theta_j may be PACKAGING_GAP relative to PARSE_POLICY; this is a representation identity. Distinct from thermal-07 (Lehmann Hilbert of many-body G(z)). No T>0 folklore: the written domain is Im tau>0 / 0<|q|<1. The 20.13 heat equation is commentary for why the identity is a thermal Green function, not an extra undeclared positivity.
